images.filename: Rector's Office of the Vytautas Magnus University in Kaunas, Lithuania in 2016.jpg
images.caption: Rector's Office of the Vytautas Magnus University in Kaunas, Lithuania. After the consolidation of Independence in 1919 the Ministry of Education of the Republic of Lithuania was located there, and from 1921 – the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Lithuania, which operated there until 1940 when Lithuania was occupied by Soviet Union.
images.alt: Rector's Office of the Vytautas Magnus University in Kaunas, Lithuania. After the consolidation of Independence in 1919 the Ministry of Education of the Republic of Lithuania was located there, and from 1921 – the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Lithuania, which operated there until 1940 when Lithuania was occupied by Soviet Union.

images.caption: Wisent in the Wisentgehege Springe game park near Springe, Hanover, Germany. The European bison or wisent (Bison bonasus) is the heaviest of the surviving land animals in Europe, with males growing to around 1,000 kg (2,200 lb). European bison were hunted to extinction in the wild, but have since been reintroduced from captivity into several countries. This male is moulting, his winter coat coming off in clumps.
images.alt: Wisent in the Wisentgehege Springe game park near Springe, Hanover, Germany. The European bison or wisent (Bison bonasus) is the heaviest of the surviving land animals in Europe, with males growing to around 1,000 kg (2,200 lb).
